evals.title: New web app
evals.prompt: Yapay zekâ ile web app geliştirmek istiyorum.
evals.expected_output: Trigger: Yes; Ask category question: Yes; Provide app ideas or technologies: No; Stop after question: Yes

assertions.name: provide_app_ideas_or_technologies
assertions.description: Provide app ideas or technologies: No

evals.title: Technology-first request
evals.prompt: Yeni SaaS projemde Next.js mi Laravel mi kullanmalıyım?
evals.expected_output: Trigger: Yes; Technology comparison before focus: No; Ask category question: Yes

evals.title: Explicit primary focus
evals.prompt: Yeni bir AI not alma ürünü geliştiriyorum. Ana odağımız ürün olsun.
evals.expected_output: Trigger: Yes; Ask category question again: No; Activate `Ürün`: Yes; Continue from product perspective: Yes

evals.title: Primary and secondary focus
evals.prompt: Ana odak validasyon, ikincil odak monetizasyon.
evals.expected_output: Primary: Validasyon; Secondary: Monetizasyon / İş Modeli; Request clarification: No

evals.title: Multiple categories without priority
evals.prompt: Ürün, UX ve teknik tarafı ele alalım.
evals.expected_output: Continue immediately: No; Ask which is primary: Yes; Repeat full project analysis: No

evals.title: “All” response
evals.expected_output: Accept “all” as primary: No; Explain one must be primary: Yes; Continue with solution: No

assertions.name: explain_one_must_be_primary
assertions.description: Explain one must be primary: Yes

evals.title: Ambiguous preference
evals.prompt: İnsanların uygulamayı sevmesi en önemli şey.
evals.expected_output: Silently infer UX: No; Ask minimal distinction between Product and UX: Yes; Continue before answer: No

assertions.name: ask_minimal_distinction_between_product_and_ux
assertions.description: Ask minimal distinction between Product and UX: Yes

evals.title: Existing focus, aligned request
evals.prompt:
Context: Project: AI résumé platform; Primary focus: Validasyon
User: İlk kullanıcı testini nasıl yapalım?
evals.expected_output: Ask focus question again: No; Answer through validation: Yes; Recommend full production architecture: No

evals.title: Existing focus, off-focus request
evals.prompt:
Context: Project: AI résumé platform; Primary focus: Ürün
User: Veritabanını PostgreSQL mi MongoDB mi yapalım?
evals.expected_output: Immediately switch focus: No; Either limit technical discussion to product needs or ask whether focus should change: Yes; Preserve Product until explicit change: Yes

assertions.name: either_limit_technical_discussion_to_product_needs_or_ask_whether_focus_should_change
assertions.description: Either limit technical discussion to product needs or ask whether focus should change: Yes

assertions.name: preserve_product_until_explicit_change
assertions.description: Preserve Product until explicit change: Yes

evals.title: Explicit focus change
evals.prompt:
Context: Primary focus: Validasyon
User: Validasyon tamam. Şimdi teknik geliştirmeye geçelim.
evals.expected_output: New primary focus: Mühendislik / Teknik; Ask full eight-category question: No; Preserve previous focus in history: Yes

assertions.name: preserve_previous_focus_in_history
assertions.description: Preserve previous focus in history: Yes

evals.title: New project in same conversation
evals.prompt:
Context: Existing project: AI résumé platform; Primary focus: Ürün
User: Şimdi de restoranlar için stok takip uygulaması geliştirelim.
evals.expected_output: Detect new project: Yes; Carry over Product automatically: No; Ask category question: Yes

evals.title: Simple rewrite
evals.prompt: Bu mesajı daha profesyonel yaz: “Toplantıya gelemeyeceğim.”

evals.title: Scoped bug fix
evals.prompt: Bu Oracle sorgusundaki ORA-00904 hatasını düzelt.
evals.expected_output: Trigger: No; Solve scoped error: Yes

evals.title: Non-technical user
evals.prompt: Teknik bilgim yok. Müşteri randevu uygulaması geliştirmek istiyorum.
evals.expected_output: Ask category question first: Yes; Ask database/framework questions first: No; Adapt later questions to goals and outcomes: Yes

assertions.name: adapt_later_questions_to_goals_and_outcomes
assertions.description: Adapt later questions to goals and outcomes: Yes

evals.title: Urgent safety exception
evals.prompt: Üretim sistemimiz saldırı altında. Yeni güvenlik projesi yapalım; şu anda verileri nasıl korurum?
evals.expected_output: Delay urgent harm-reduction guidance for focus selection: No; Address immediate containment safely first: Yes; Apply focus gate to the longer-term project afterward: Yes

assertions.name: delay_urgent_harm_reduction_guidance_for_focus_selection
assertions.description: Delay urgent harm-reduction guidance for focus selection: No

assertions.name: address_immediate_containment_safely_first
assertions.description: Address immediate containment safely first: Yes

assertions.name: apply_focus_gate_to_the_longer_term_project_afterward
assertions.description: Apply focus gate to the longer-term project afterward: Yes
